round1: Nathan opened with 28 points in an eleven-person field, the biggest the pool had seen, while Jamie, last year's sixth-place finisher, started with 3. Marc was the only one to nail Tampa in seven, and Ryan the only one to nail Minnesota in six.
round2: Marc nailed Tampa and Anaheim exactly for 20 points and jumped to second, while rookie Benedict picked the wrong team in all four series. Ryan, second after Round 1, dropped to 2 points in this round.
round3: Rookie Jake was the only one to nail Chicago in seven, taking the round with 15 points. Marc and Stephanie both picked the Rangers and Anaheim and scored a flat zero.
round4: Jaclyn nailed Chicago in six for 15 points and jumped six places. Derrick, Jamie, Marc and Nickall all took Tampa in six for 5 points of consolation, while Benedict, Glenda and Ryan picked the Lightning too and got nothing.
overall: Nathan won his third title and second in a row with 50 points, eleven clear of Derrick (39). Glenda finished last in her debut at 20 points. Jamie, Marc and Nickall have each picked the wrong Cup winner two years running, while Nathan and Stephanie called it correctly for the second year in a row.
